correctness.rationale: At the assigned tree, every neighborhood facet is the simplex of k-subsets of a (k+1)-subset, and distinct such facets meet in at most one vertex. On each facet the gap of the largest and second-largest barycentric coordinates continuously retracts onto the barycenter-to-vertex star, fixing overlap vertices, and therefore the facet maps glue equivariantly for every k≥2. The middle-level inclusion graph has 2 binomial(2k+1,k) nodes and (k+1) binomial(2k+1,k) edges and is connected by one-element swaps, giving H1 rank (k-1)binomial(2k+1,k)+1. In the augmented rational cellular chain sequence the flag module has characteristic h_k^2h_1 and the vertex module 2h_kh_(k+1); Pieri subtraction yields exactly sum_{i=1}^k Specht(2k-i,i,1). An independent hook-length/dimension recalculation gives H1 ranks 11,71,379,1849 for k=2,3,4,5. Rank/finite character checks supplement rather than replace this uniform proof.
residual_risks: Finite diagnostics alone cannot prove the universal aspects; the cited arguments supply those steps.
